challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.
challenge.roundIntroduction: The compliance team suspended access to the loyalty app basket feed after discovering that retention policies were not documented in the data contracts. The KPI definitions for the next promotion cycle were never formally agreed upon, leaving the team without a clear baseline for how to handle the missing personal data signals.

on_enter_ops.reason: compliance audit found missing consent fields in the schema

stalemate_ops.reason: legal team blocked KPI sign off due to unresolved data rights

roster.name: Efficiency Emilia
roster.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.
roster.priorities: Applying deep domain knowledge to ensure models fulfill specific business goals. Aligning ML solutions with clear objectives, KPIs, and business goals. Making organization-level decisions and enhancing overall operational capability. Defining products by defining and optimizing product features.

roster.name: Requirements Reuben
roster.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.
roster.priorities: Guaranteeing high product quality through rigorous testing of applications. Guaranteeing the integrity, confidentiality, and security of all ML assets. Meeting internal and external compliance and data protection standards. Keeping infrastructure stable, reproducible, and cost-controlled.

roster.name: Automation Alex
roster.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.
roster.priorities: Building automated pipelines and maintaining full system operational stability. Ensuring seamless deployment, integration, and stability of models and services in production.

roster.name: Reliability Ruth
roster.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.
roster.priorities: Pushes the delivery of reliable ML-powered features that directly improve the user experience. CI/CD and working feedback loops. Identifying and reporting issues to facilitate iterative improvements.

items.fact: {requirements_reuben} asked for the data contracts and the hand-over into ingestion to be fully governed and automated.

readings.driver: He wants the consent checks to run automatically at the boundary so no personal data enters the pipeline without a valid record.
readings.boundary: He will not allow any data to move forward unless the contract is fully automated and governed.
readings.trade_off: He would accept a slower rollout if the consent checks are guaranteed to catch every violation.
readings.fact: That is simply how the validation setup works today.

readings.driver: He wants the governance to be stronger to ensure compliance.
